title: aigdbench TaskPackage result (domainKind aigamedevbench.result/v1)
description: Result envelope written to /out/result.json by .beaver/tasks/aigdbench/run.sh. Opaque to BeaverHub (ADR-0068 SS4 rule 5) -- only this repo's own consumers (dashboard, CI provider, an operator) interpret mean_score/checks.

testcase.description: The testcase id that was scored (echoes input.testcase, or the schema default when omitted).

status.description: Derived from the scorer process's own exit code (0 -> success, non-zero -> failed) -- never from mean_score. A correctly-measured noop=0.00 run is status=success.

exit_code.description: The aigdbench CLI's verbatim process exit code.

mean_score.description: 0..1 checkpoint-weighted score for the single scored testcase, or null if the report could not be parsed (see status/exit_code for why).

checks.description: Per-checkpoint verifier detail, when the CLI's run report included one (folder/git testcases with a godot_scene_assert or similar checkpoints verifier).

stdout_path.description: /out-rooted path to the captured aigdbench CLI stdout.

stderr_path.description: /out-rooted path to the captured aigdbench CLI stderr.
